title: Actual tower purity Cartesian source and counit words

from.place: Steps 1–2, the actual whole-tower composition and Cartesian source/counit words before realization

statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, the ordinary strict coefficient-tower operations of [def-sp-tower-shriek-data] and their section-normalized constructible finite-Tor coordinates [def-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-interfaces]. For a compactification $c$ of $f:X\to Y$, with $X,Y$ Noetherian, and supplied tower support membership, right adjoint $G$, adjunction and finite levels, define towerFactorizationLevels by transporting that same level package along $c.i;c.g=f$. Define TowerPurityAt to be exactly the existing tower purity datum [def-sp-tower-gamma-data] in those transported factorization coordinates. Define towerTensorMap and towerGamma as the actual projection/counit tensor transpose and its oriented gamma composite from that datum, transporting only this compactification equation.

For a Cartesian square $fu=vf'$ [def-pc-base-change] and its supplied actual tower adjunction/mate data $a$ [def-sp-tower-mate-data], let $x$ be the specified open exchange and assume its restricted compact-support exchange $\beta$ invertible. Define towerExchange at $K$ to be the inverse section-realization counit followed by the realization of the actual exceptional mate component $e_K$. Define towerPullSquare to be the inverse of the specified inverse-image square isomorphism followed by pullback of the inverse realization counit for $v^*K$. Define towerTensorComparison by the tensor-pullback comparison and the tensor of towerPullSquare with the identity of a supplied tower object $W$. For supplied membership certificates for the unit objects and a specified strict unit isomorphism $s:v^*1_Y\cong1_{Y'}$, define towerUnitIdentification as the inverse coordinate realization of the actual pullback of the realization counit followed by $s$. Finally define towerUnitExchange as towerExchange at the unit followed by $G'$ of towerUnitIdentification. All arrows and categories here are those actual existing constructions; no orientation, tensor, gamma or finite-reduction compatibility theorem is asserted by this definition node.
